note: Where a fibre's polymer comes from (fiber.fiber_origin). Values follow the material_bank v0.2 enum (ADR-0004); our wording. A yarn's yarn_type is derived from its fibres' origins: unknown if any is unknown, the origin itself if there is one, blend otherwise.

terms.label: natural
terms.definition: Grown: taken from plants or animals without dissolving the polymer.

terms.label: regenerated
terms.definition: A natural polymer, usually cellulose, dissolved and spun into a new fibre.

terms.label: synthetic
terms.definition: A polymer built from small molecules, usually from oil or recycled plastic, then spun.
